title: 🧭 A Simpler Map + Season Impact
notes: 🔮 New: Season Impact. Build a trade and the meter shows what it does to both teams this year: playoff odds, title odds and points per week, before and after. Trade Finder ideas show it too.

📋 Research now opens on your Briefing: one screen with your odds, your next game, the one move to make, who's rising and falling on your roster, a buy-low target and the latest headline. Tap any line for the full story.
🗂️ The Trades tab is now four short tabs: Offers, Find, Build and Feed. A red number on Offers (and a dot on the Trades button) means someone is waiting on you.
⚙️ One Settings button (the gear, top right) for your team, layout, colors, notifications and patch notes. Commissioner tools live there too.
📦 Where things moved: your offers are on Trades > Offers. Draft picks are under every team on Rosters. Your trade history is on Trades > Feed > My trades.
👋 Retired: the old My Team page, the Smart Trade Matchmaker (Find and Plan do its job better) and the Compact layout. If you used Compact, you're on Classic now.
📜 Activity loads 20 items at a time, so it opens faster.
